walkthrough:
On the x-axis, y=0, leaving a quadratic in x.
Set $y = 0$ to find where the circle crosses the $x$-axis:
$$x^2 + 0^2 - 6x - 8(0) - 27 = 0$$
$$x^2 - 6x - 27 = 0$$

Factorise and solve the quadratic equation:
$$(x - 9)(x + 3) = 0 \implies x = 9 \quad \text{or} \quad x = -3$$
$$A(-3, 0) \quad \text{and} \quad B(9, 0)$$

hints: Complete the square to find centre: $(x - 3)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 27 + 9 + 16 = 52 \implies \text{Centre is } (3, 4)$.
The distance from centre $(3, 4)$ to chord $AB$ (on line $y = 0$) is $|4| = 4$.
walkthrough:
On the x-axis, y=0, leaving a quadratic in x.
Calculate the length of the horizontal chord $AB$:
$$AB = |9 - (-3)| = 12$$

Complete the square to find the centre coordinates:
$$(x - 3)^2 - 9 + (y - 4)^2 - 16 - 27 = 0$$
$$(x - 3)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 52$$
$$\text{Centre } = (3, 4)$$
$$\text{Perpendicular distance from } (3, 4) \text{ to } y = 0 \text{ is } 4$$
